paragraphs: Iteris sells cloud-enabled solutions delivered through its ClearMobility Platform, which monitor, visualize and optimize mobility infrastructure and help bridge legacy technology silos. The company also supplies advanced detection sensors and traffic signal design, timing and synchronization services to transportation agencies. On its ESG page Iteris says it has completed more than 3,000 traffic signal timing, coordination or synchronization projects covering over 27,000 intersections across 20 states.

More than 7,000 public agencies and private-sector enterprises focused on mobility rely on Iteris every day, according to the about page. For public transportation agencies and commercial enterprises, the company offers solutions covering safety, mobility and sustainability for road users in their jurisdictions. The ESG page describes helping city and state transportation agencies, and commercial enterprises improve the sustainability of their transportation systems.

quote.text: Enabling safe, efficient, and sustainable mobility.
